reviews.text: These guys are great. I called them last minute. They showed up a couple hours later. Got the job done, cleaned up after themselves. I will definitely be calling them again for any handyman services.

I have used this company several times.  They are two hard working, honest men that aim to please their customers and reasonably priced.  They are also very personable and multitalented.  I would highly recommend them.

I highly recommend the Coastal Handy Dudes as I call them! They have done lots of work for me-all kinds -from mounting complicated Art pieces, installing & building custom workspaces for my Art studio, changing out ceiling fans and light fixtures &  much more.
Their work ethic is superior, communication is clear & timely, their prices are more than fair & they are a lot of fun to have around. I’m a client for life-no need to look any further-I found my Pros!

facts.about_text: Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen is a local, family-owned, veteran-owned handyman service proudly helping homeowners, condos, rental properties, and Airbnb owners in Myrtle Beach and North Myrtle Beach. We specialize in small to medium home repairs and upgrades with clean, professional results and dependable communication. No subcontractors — every job is handled personally with care and attention to detail.
